signature: validate_planned_figure_identities(pairs: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], cell_refs: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> None

parameters.pairs: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] representing planned comparison pairs (invoked immediately after select_explicit_pairs)
parameters.cell_refs: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] representing unique cell references (e.g. supplement['unique_cells'])

exceptions.TypeError: Raised when pairs/cell_refs are not Sequences (or are str/bytes) or their elements are not Mappings
exceptions.ValueError: Raised on missing/empty/whitespace protocol or cell fields, non-finite/bool/missing target_x_m, repeated ordered identities in either namespace, or distinct identities yielding colliding production stems

namespaces.cells: figures/cells/<slug(cell)>, using production _slug(cell) where current 26 cell stems are distinct
namespaces.comparisons: figures/comparisons/<pair_comparison_slug(pair)>, derived from canonical exact JSON identity serialization

pipeline_integration_point: Pipeline invokes immediately after select_explicit_pairs and before _pair_result bootstrap; existing pipeline resolved-path guard in _verify_figure_assets remains sole completed-ledger check
